Make transitioning from bottle to cup easy with the GreenSprout 280ml Cute Baby Sippy Cup. Designed for toddlers and kids, this straw handle training bottle encourages self-feeding while reducing spills.

Ideal for home, daycare, or travel, this sippy cup makes learning to drink independently both fun and safe.

Designed for Toddler Independence

The 280ml capacity provides the right amount of liquid for growing toddlers without being too heavy for small hands. The dual-handle design allows your child to hold the cup comfortably from either side, building confidence and motor skills with every sip. The straw mechanism teaches proper drinking techniques while protecting emerging teeth from bottle-related issues.

Safe Materials for Peace of Mind

Parents can trust the GreenSprout sippy cup's commitment to safety. Constructed entirely from BPA-free, food-grade materials, this training bottle contains no harmful chemicals or toxins. The durable construction withstands drops and tumbles that come with toddler use, while remaining easy to clean and maintain for daily use.

Spill-Proof Design for Less Mess

The integrated spill-proof straw system minimizes leaks and spills during the learning process. Whether at home, in the car, or at daycare, this training bottle keeps liquids contained while allowing easy access when your child drinks. The secure lid prevents accidental spills when the cup tips over, making it practical for both parents and caregivers.

Key Features:

  • Cute & Functional Design: Attractive design that kids love.

Portable Design: Compact dimensions (20x5x5cm) make it ideal for home use and travel feeding.

1. Fill the silicone bottle with your baby's food or puree.

4. Feed your baby slowly while maintaining a comfortable pace.
